title: AI and Patient Safety in the Nuclear Medicine Outpatient Clinic
summary: Due to the increasing availability of easily accessible, free, and publicly available AI systems, their use by patients is expected to rise. We aim to examine the implications this has for patient safety, communication with patients, and the resulting consequences for their further treatment.
conditions: Various clinical conditions encountered in the nuclear medicine outpatient clinic will be examined.

interventions.name: Retrospective, single-arm analysis as part of basic research on pattern recognition and analysis using AI.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•	Examination in the nuclear medicine outpatient clinic of the Department of Nuclear Medicine, Aachen
•	Availability of complete imaging, laboratory, and report data (depending on the modality examined)
Exclusion criteria:
•	Insufficient image quality
•	Incomplete datasets (missing laboratory values, reports, or imaging data)
